title: Release Candidate Approval Gate
objective: Menentukan apakah v1.2.0-rc.1 dapat diterbitkan untuk validasi terbatas tanpa mengubah batas klaim lokal menjadi persetujuan publik.
open_issues: Hosted CI pada exact candidate SHA belum dijalankan karena billing/runner gate.
Public CA signing dan RFC3161 timestamp belum tersedia; artifact hanya trusted CurrentUser.
Installer packaging, native uninstall, native GUI, hardware power-loss, dan USB cold-eject belum diverifikasi.
Publication/deployment belum diotorisasi dan belum dilakukan.

residual_risks.mitigation: Batasi artifact pada validasi lokal terbatas sampai CA signing dan timestamp tersedia.

residual_risks.risk: Perbedaan runtime native dan hardware tidak tercakup gate lokal
residual_risks.mitigation: Jalankan validation window pada target hardware/distribution yang disetujui sebelum publikasi.

rollback_readiness.limitation: Tidak cukup untuk menyatakan public release atau menghapus backup sebelum validation window selesai.

decision_basis: Local feature, integration, migration, quality-gate, rollback, and signed-artifact evidence exist; external distribution gates remain open.
limits: This gate records a fail-closed local decision and does not publish, push, tag, or deploy anything.
The signed artifact is locally verified but uses a CurrentUser-only self-signed certificate and is not RFC3161 timestamped.
Choirudin must explicitly approve any hosted validation, public release, installer publication, or distribution communication.
